reason: I'd probably try the 40 free docs, but my guys and I already live with the group chat and a messy sheet, and I can rig an n8n plus ChatGPT flow to dump receipts into Sheets over a weekend. Paying monthly for something I could build myself isn't a sure thing.
objection: Once the free part runs out, nobody on my team will care enough to keep using it. And the basic version is something I could build myself.
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial actually caught a duplicate or padded receipt that my homemade setup would have missed, i.e. it saves me real money on a project, I'd pay without thinking.
